info: Reduced soft-sprite black flashes during HGR present (e.g. Galaxian invaders) with a one-/two-present erase-hold on HGR bytes, without freezing the whole frame on a VRAM-quiet wait.
Stopped forced mid-play HGR refreshes on the RLCD 4.2 path that reintroduced tear samples; text mode still gets an occasional refresh for cursor/ROM updates.

Added Waveshare/Luckfox ESP32-S3-RLCD-4.2 as an ESP][ target (ST7305 mono): PlatformIO envs rlcd42_bringup / rlcd42_display_probe / rlcd42_apple2, SDMMC 1-bit SD, KEY/BOOT Control Center (PHYSICALLY_VERIFIED Galaxian boot path).
RLCD classic present defaults to sharp integer 1× (280×192 with letterbox); optional full-panel fit remains available in the Display menu.
Sped up RLCD frame output with batched ST7305 SPI transfers and a one-pass mono pack (drawPixel flush was the previous bottleneck).
Shipped on-device Control Center as a frontend over existing presentation, Disk II, BLE HID, and SD-ownership services (touch on AMOLED; buttons on RLCD).
Expanded multi-board Project Control: diymore ES3C28P and RLCD 4.2 platform IDs alongside the Waveshare AMOLED production baseline.
Fixed a long-run Apple II throttle stall caused by the 32-bit microsecond timer wrapping after about 71.6 minutes; Galaxian now passes a 2-hour physical soak test (PHYSICALLY_VERIFIED).
Added verified ESP][ SD backup and restore for card migration and recovery.

Verified Little Brick Out as a second real-software title on the physical ESP][: LORES+MIXED playfield on the CO5300, with the Windows USB/CDC multi-input bridge ready for Logitech Dial as Apple II paddle 0.
Added Green and Amber phosphor monitor appearances plus an optional lightweight CRT/TV display effect, composed independently from Classic/Landscape orientation and Artifact Color.
Introduced RELEASES.json with µGulp release-history workflow (en-US source, 30-day contributor merge, release-info context tags).
